build_mask_rcnn_model: build a MaskRCNN detector with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck using MMDetDetector
configure_rpn_head: configure the RPN head with AnchorGenerator scales, ratios, and strides for object proposal generation
configure_roi_head: configure the StandardRoIHead with bbox and mask extractors for instance segmentation on 80 classes
configure_train_cfg: configure training settings for RPN and RCNN including IoU assigners and random samplers
configure_test_cfg: configure test settings for RPN and RCNN including NMS thresholds and score filtering
